notes: Small single-discipline electrical bid set (8 sheets) adding a standby generator to an existing public works building. Truth is taken from sheet E-402 'New Work One-Line Diagram' (its keynotes and the BASE BID FEEDER SCHEDULE) and sheet E-201 'Enlarged New Work Plans' keynotes; the text layer on those sheets is clean, so this was read from extracted text and confirmed against the sheet layout. NOT enumerated, hence partial: E-101 demolition plan, E-200 overall new work plan (which carries additional underground conduit runs), and E-501 installation details. The defining feature of this document is that almost everything drawn on the one-line is EXISTING — the 1200A MDP, seven 75 kVA transformers TA-TG, and roughly twenty 480V and 208V panelboards are the existing building distribution, and the ATS and fire-pump controller are explicitly keynoted as existing. Only the generator, three feeders, one breaker and the emergency-power-off wiring are procured. The `forbidden` list covers the two items the drawings state outright are existing plus the utility-owned transformer; the existing panelboards and 75 kVA transformers are almost certainly the same trap but the sheets do not label them 'existing' individually, so they are left out of `forbidden` rather than guessed — a reviewer who confirms them against sheet E-401 (demolition one-line) should add them. Feeder conduit and conductor LENGTHS are not dimensioned; the schedule gives quantity of runs, sets, conductors per set and sizes, so run counts are stated and footages are null. The generator concrete slab (E-201 keynote 2) is real scope but has no electrical_plan category and is omitted.
